title: AccessPreview
description: Wire shape of `explanation` for `bregctl explain access --scenario <file>`. The offline synthetic-admission result is a small hand-written struct and is pinned in full, except `effectiveProfile`, which is a passthrough of a compiled access profile and is declared opaque.

effectiveProfile.description: Passthrough of the compiled access profile the scenario resolved to, or null when no profile matched. Shape follows AccessProfileSource and is outside this contract version.
